name: Real Earth
description: The real Earth at one block per metre: real elevation, water, roads, railways, towns with their buildings, land cover and climate, as a dimension (a lapis frame lit with a Globe Banner Pattern) or a world type. Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); building detail (c) Overture Maps Foundation (ODbL); Terrain Tiles (USGS and others); (c) ESA WorldCover 2021 (CC BY 4.0); Koppen-Geiger, Beck et al. 2023 (CC BY 4.0). Full credits: CREDITS.md in the jar, or /earth credits.
